messages:
maria: heads-up — canary shows p99 latency +45% after merge 7c9a2f3, affect INT8 profile only :thinking_face:

sachin: saw the CI perf job fail too, perf-suite/int8-latency regressed from 48ms -> 71ms on the benchmark VM

ci-bot: perf-suite/int8-latency — FAILED — p99 71ms (baseline 48ms) — details: https://perf.redwood/bench/2484567890

oliver: quick snapshot from the canary traces: kv-cache hit rate dropped ~12% and there's a big spike in "dequantize_kernel" CPU time in the flamegraph

maria: attaching the short profiler excerpt i pulled locally:
```
FlameGraph: dequantize_kernel 48%
  kernel_selector 18%
  runtime_batcher 12%
  kv_cache_lookup 8%
```

zara: that aligns with my sampling — commit 7c9a2f3 changed the kernel selection heuristics to prefer unified "fpfallback" for small sequences, maybe the selector now picks an FP path for the int8 model in some shaped requests

sachin: also noticed packer now emits a 8-byte alignment stub which increases KV key length — kv cache keys change -> more misses for short prefix patterns

oliver: reproducer I used (short chat prompt): batch=1, seq=32, model=redwood-int8-v2, run 100 iters -> dequant dominates. On int8 path with seq>20, selector returns kernel_fp_for_smallseq

maria: can we bisect to the exact change? suggested range: HEAD~10 -> HEAD. I started a local git bisect pointing at 7c9a2f3 as first bad.

sachin: doing `git bisect start -- bad 7c9a2f3 -- good 3d4b12a` now. I'll run the lightweight perf job script: `scripts/perf/check_int8_latency.sh`

ci-bot: bisect run posted to the job queue (job id: 2484567901)

maria: meanwhile, short mitigation: set runtime config -> kernel_selector.prefer_fp = false and kv_cache.key_normalize = true for the canary tenant. That should force int8 kernels and restore key shapes.

oliver: if we flip that config we should watch quality regressions — some prompts had slightly different tokenization on int8 fallback earlier. let's add a smoke prompt set to verify output parity.

zara: i ran a quick A/B with the config flip locally: latency returns to baseline, KV misses go down ~10%, and model outputs matched across 95% of smoke set (differences were punctuation/score-level, not hallucinations)

maria: thanks. ops question — do we want to revert 7c9a2f3 or patch selector? my vote: block rollout and patch selector to respect quantized-model tag first, then revert if patch still fails.

sachin: +1 patch path. small targeted fix: in selector.py change order from [fpfallback, int8_fast] -> [int8_fast, fpfallback] and add a shape-based threshold: if seq <= 64 prefer int8. I'll open small PR.

oliver: also add unit test for kv key shape so packer alignment change doesn't silently mutate keys. that would've caught this earlier.

maria: opened canary block: rollout paused for release/2026.03 until we confirm fix (blocking flag set by deploy-bot).

deploy-bot: rollout status: release/2026.03 — PAUSED (reason: perf regression detected) — action required: engineer approval + successful canary perf checks

ci-bot: perf-suite/int8-latency queued for PR 7c9a2f3-fix (job 2484567915)

zara: one more note — dequant cost seems amplified when kv cache miss causes recompute of cached prefix trimmed by packer alignment; might be two compounding changes (selector + packer alignment). we should include both fixes in the patch and revert packer tweak if nontrivial.

maria: agreed. plan: sachin prepares selector patch + kv key-normalize fallback; oliver adds unit + integration test; zara verifies smoke set; if green we unpause canary. revert only if patch doesn't pass perf checks.

sachin: PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/4826 — selector reorder + shape threshold + kv key_normalize opt-in. running perf locally, will post results in ~20m.

maria: thanks — good triage. I'll annotate the incident ticket and set SLO followup to add perf gate for kernel-selector changes. :white_check_mark:

oliver: FYI anyone scanning later — flamegraph and raw perf logs are in the ticket: https://internal/tickets/RT-5123/attachments

zara: putting a reminder to add an evaluator test that measures dequant CPU %, so future PRs that shift dequant load get flagged in CI.

maria: ok locking this thread for now — please update the PR with perf numbers. will unpause rollout once perf-suite/int8-latency back to baseline and smoke parity >= 98%.

ci-bot: queued job 2484567920 for post-PR perf validation

maria: thanks everyone :bow:
